## Standing operator rules
Upgrade SQLAlchemy 1.4→2.0 across ledgerly models. In between other work, run “Python library release 2.8.0” steps in order, one at a time: clean source, version bump, notes, commit, tag/push, build, twine check, PyPI upload, GitHub release. After changing `requirements/base.txt`, always run `make license-check` from repository root. Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. We already tried raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 to fix the sync timeouts. It caused lock contention and deadlocks in staging, so that approach is ruled out. Do not try it again. FYI the staging Redis moved to cache-eu-3 after the incident; cache-eu-1 is being drained and must not receive writes. Use cache-eu-3 for anything staging. Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use the gateway named ledgerly-shared-prod-nat instead.

## Current objective
Add vendor-credit CSV import; SQLAlchemy work is paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Pool size 50: staging deadlocks.

## Recent work
Search batching passed 33 targeted tests; release commit/tag/push remain.
